## Usage notes

### button

Reach for `asChild` rather than a new component whenever the thing being pressed is really a link — `<Button asChild><Link href="/settings">Settings</Link></Button>`. The `link` variant is for a button that LOOKS like a link inside a sentence; it is still a button, and it still does something rather than going somewhere.

```tsx
<Button variant="destructive" size="sm">
  Delete files
</Button>
```

> The `link` variant uses --primary-strong, not --primary. The brand measures 3.164:1 on a light ground: enough for a focus ring, not enough for text.
